V8 · ECC82 mod (vibrato strip — not drawn)
V7 · ECC83 vib (vibrato strip — not drawn)

Redrawn from JMI drawing OS/065, "VOX A.C.30.36 AMPLIFIER CIRCUIT / NORMAL" (title-block date 29-4-60, main body as amended to Issue 4 of 11-9-64) — layout DERIVED from that circuit drawing; JMI published no board-layout sheet for the AC30/6 and none was located — not a trace
T2 — HT secondary 280-0-280 V at 160 mA · 6.3 V, 6 A heater winding · 5 V, 2 A rectifier winding · primary taps 115/160/205/225/245 V
T1 — 4 kΩ anode-to-anode primary · 8 Ω / 15 Ω secondary taps
Note: the 6.3 V heater twisted pair always routes on the top layer and never joins another run — its crossings are not hop-overs.
